## Compliance Checklist

> All items must be checked before merging. See the [Contributor Guide](https://docs.google.com/document/d/10ee5pJyqt8Lj5kj9ASoSfORG7YzYG0cxBHJIh77s16k/) for details.

- [ ] **No external data included** — This PR does not add any third-party datasets to the repository (even if permissively licensed). Users are prompted to download data themselves.
- [ ] **No customer/confidential data included** — This PR does not add any customer/confidential data to the repository.
- [ ] **No "Snow"-prefixed sample names** — Sample databases, schemas, and brand names do not use "Snow" prefix (e.g., SnowStore, SnowLeague). PMM approval is required for any "Snow" naming.
- [ ] **Unofficial disclaimer present** — README.md clearly states this is an unofficial plugin, not an officially supported Snowflake product.
- [ ] **No plugin-installs-plugin** — This PR does not install other plugins.
